summaryZh: Winzeler 实验室以消除疟疾为目标，开展表型筛选与化合物测试以寻找治疗和预防途径。研究结合化学生物学、体外进化和全基因组测序发现药物靶点，并研究疟原虫与肝细胞相互作用及耐药性。
researchQuestions: 疟原虫如何与人肝细胞相互作用？

evidence.quote: The lab conducts phenotypic screens and compound testing to accelerate the search for new malaria treatments and malaria prevention methods
We use chemical biology, in vitro evolution and whole genome sequencing
We are interested in host pathogen signaling and how malaria parasites interact with human liver cells
We are using a variety of experimental systems, including yeast and human cells, to understand how drug resistance emerges
